title: UNCLOS & Maritime Security Architecture in the Indo-Pacific
prelims_pointers: UNCLOS defines Territorial Waters (12 NM), Contiguous Zone (24 NM), and Exclusive Economic Zone (200 NM).
International Seabed Authority (ISA) regulates mineral-related activities in international seabed areas.
India's SAGAR doctrine (Security and Growth for All in the Region) guides maritime diplomacy.

mains_perspective.context: Ensuring a rules-based order, freedom of navigation, and overflight in critical sea lines of communication.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Rising maritime friction, non-traditional security threats (piracy, IUU fishing), and strategic bottlenecks.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Strengthen Quad Maritime Domain Awareness and operationalize joint bilateral naval exercises.

title: Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act & Macroeconomic Stability
prelims_pointers: NK Singh Committee recommended a Debt-to-GDP ratio target of 60% (40% Centre, 20% States).
Escape clause under FRBM allows deviation during national security, calamity, or structural collapse.

mains_perspective.context: Balancing growth-oriented capital spending with medium-term fiscal consolidation targets.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: High revenue expenditure, off-budget liabilities, and state-level fiscal deficits pressure public finances.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Establish an independent Fiscal Council to audit budget assumptions and enforce fiscal discipline.

mains_perspective.title: 2nd ARC Recommendations on Ethics in Governance & Probity
prelims_pointers: 2nd ARC 4th Report specifically addresses Ethics in Governance.
CVC Act 2003 grants statutory status to Central Vigilance Commission.

mains_perspective.context: Building transparent, accountable administrative systems to eliminate discretionary corruption.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Administrative opacity, lack of whistleblower protection, and delayed departmental proceedings undermine integrity.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Implement mandatory e-governance audits, proactive RTI disclosures, and value-based civil service training.

mains_perspective.title: Preservation of Coastal Fortresses & Maratha Heritage Architecture
prelims_pointers: Maratha Military Landscapes were nominated for UNESCO World Heritage site recognition.
Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) acts as statutory custodian under AMASR Act 1958.

mains_perspective.context: Strategic conservation of 17th-century coastal, sea, and hill fort structures across Western India.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Promoting sustainable eco-tourism while preventing structural degradation from coastal weathering.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Adopt scientific stone preservation methods and community-led heritage management.
